text:

Thank you for letting me know where the board stands. I really want to make this work for you, and I completely understand that budgets are tight as a small charity.

My standard rate is £450 a day, and the lowest charity rate I am able to come down to is £320 a day (just under a 30% discount), so I can't quite stretch to £290 a day across the full 12 days.

I have clear availability coming up and would love to get started on this with you. Please let me know which option works best for you and the board, and I will put the agreement together right away.
